name: jevmcp
description: Jev tools for coding agents, in one plugin: spec-drift checking, CI failure triage and code audit. A fast model (TypeSafe's Jev) screens - each requirement against its code, each failure of a CI run against the change under test, each of your project's own rules against the code it covers - and the agent investigates only what it flags. More tools are added to this same plugin, so you install once.

typesafe_api_key.title: TypeSafe API key
typesafe_api_key.description: Asked for when you enable the plugin - there is no file to create. Used only by the jevmcp MCP server to call api.typesafe.ai. Claude Code keeps it out of settings files (macOS Keychain, or ~/.claude/.credentials.json elsewhere) and never shows it to the model. Change it later with /plugin manage. Get a key at https://console.typesafe.ai
